Calculation notes / incomplete sections

    The original sheet’s 12-hour dog plan divided maintenance and ongoing losses by 12 as well; this page changes only the deficit replacement time, matching the current Fluid Planner. Impossible sodium mixtures produce a message rather than a negative additive. The norepinephrine dose unit is mcg/kg/min. Blood log entries are temporary handwritten-style records, not rolling totals; Clear patient clears these entries.

    Layout: original Fluids!C3:V60. Clinical context and detailed preparation controls remain on the dedicated pages.
